design.order: Odd repetition PERIOD then serialized; even repetition serialized then PERIOD
design.completion_requirement: All planned attempts accounted for; genuine incomplete outcomes remain admissible and excluded from completed-result estimates
design.pooling_scope: One batch, with paired comparisons confined to each case

warnings: Unmodified serialized failures have no valid scheduler outcome. Historical witnesses/author_serialized copies may be stale PERIOD files; this analysis never uses witness counts or attribution.
Runtime summaries are per case and batch only. CPU labels are not host identifiers; there is no pooled cross-host speedup.
Paper gaps are descriptive reproduction gaps. The ABI-adapted released serialized driver has not been proven identical to the historical Table 2 executable.

Wilson and exact McNemar outputs are optional model-based diagnostics. Independence of repeated trials or pairs is not established by AB/BA ordering; all-hit outcomes do not prove equality. Descriptive counts and mean/sample SD are the primary results.

diagnostics.interpretation: One fixed witness on one host. Wilson intervals assume an appropriate independent Bernoulli model; exact McNemar assumes independent pairs with exchangeable discordant directions under its null. Sequential repetitions on one host can be dependent. These optional model-based quantities do not establish equality when both conditions always hit. The primary report uses descriptive counts and mean/sample SD.
